who.en:
Afya Glow is the everyday skin, hair and personal-care box for women aged 20 to 59 in Dar es Salaam. The city is hot and humid all year and close to the equator, so the sun is strong every day: skin sweats, hair dries out and dark marks darken. The box covers what a woman uses each month: a gentle face cleanser, a moisturiser and a daily broad-spectrum sunscreen; body lotion and a mild beauty bar; an antiperspirant; shampoo and a leave-in conditioner for natural hair; fluoride toothpaste, a toothbrush and floss; a lip balm; and one spare pack of pads.

Sun protection for darker skin. WHO advises shade, a hat and broad-spectrum sunscreen on skin that clothes do not cover, and notes that darker-skinned people also develop skin cancers. For dark skin the daily gain is an even tone: sun makes dark patches, acne marks and melasma darker, so a daily sunscreen does more for an even tone than any cream sold to lighten.

No skin lighteners, ever. WHO warns that skin-lightening products often contain mercury, which damages the kidneys and nervous system and harms the unborn child, and other hazardous chemicals such as hydroquinone. The Minamata Convention bars cosmetics with more than 1 ppm of mercury. Tanzania bans cosmetics containing mercury or hydroquinone, and the Tanzania Bureau of Standards publishes a list of banned products. Afya Basics never sells or recommends a lightening product, a "whitening" soap or a steroid cream for the face. A member who wants to treat dark patches or acne is offered a partner skin consultation instead.

Period care stays light. One pack of pads is a spare for an early or unexpected period. Full period care is the separate Afya Siku box. The box holds no medicines.
who.sw:
Afya Glow ni sanduku la kila siku la huduma ya ngozi, nywele na mwili kwa wanawake wenye umri wa miaka 20 hadi 59 jijini Dar es Salaam. Jiji lina joto na unyevu mwaka mzima na liko karibu na ikweta, hivyo jua ni kali kila siku: ngozi hutoa jasho, nywele hukauka na madoa meusi huzidi kuwa meusi. Sanduku lina kile ambacho mwanamke hutumia kila mwezi: kisafishaji laini cha uso, krimu ya unyevu na kinga ya jua ya wigo mpana ya kila siku; losheni ya mwili na sabuni laini ya kuogea; antiperspirant; shampuu na kiyoyozi cha kuacha kwa nywele za asili; dawa ya meno yenye floraidi, mswaki na uzi wa meno; mafuta ya midomo; na pakiti moja ya akiba ya taulo za kike.

Kinga ya jua kwa ngozi nyeusi. WHO inashauri kivuli, kofia na kinga ya jua ya wigo mpana kwenye ngozi isiyofunikwa na nguo, na inaeleza kuwa watu wenye ngozi nyeusi pia hupata saratani ya ngozi. Kwa ngozi nyeusi faida ya kila siku ni rangi iliyo sawa: jua hufanya mabaka meusi, alama za chunusi na melasma kuwa meusi zaidi, hivyo kinga ya jua ya kila siku husaidia rangi iwe sawa kuliko krimu yoyote inayouzwa kwa ajili ya kuchubua.

Hakuna vipodozi vya kuchubua, kamwe. WHO inaonya kuwa bidhaa za kuchubua ngozi mara nyingi zina zebaki, inayoharibu figo na mfumo wa fahamu na kumdhuru mtoto aliye tumboni, pamoja na kemikali nyingine hatari kama haidrokwinoni. Mkataba wa Minamata unakataza vipodozi vyenye zebaki zaidi ya ppm 1. Tanzania imepiga marufuku vipodozi vyenye zebaki au haidrokwinoni, na Shirika la Viwango Tanzania (TBS) huchapisha orodha ya bidhaa zilizopigwa marufuku. Afya Basics haiuzi wala haipendekezi kamwe bidhaa ya kuchubua, sabuni ya "kung’arisha" au krimu ya steroidi kwa uso. Mwanachama anayetaka kutibu mabaka meusi au chunusi hupewa ushauri wa daktari wa ngozi mshirika badala yake.

Huduma ya hedhi ni kidogo tu. Pakiti moja ya taulo za kike ni akiba kwa hedhi iliyowahi au isiyotarajiwa. Huduma kamili ya hedhi ni sanduku tofauti la Afya Siku. Sanduku hili halina dawa.

clinic_line.en: A dark patch that spreads, a mole that changes, acne that scars, a rash from a cream, or very heavy periods are seen by a clinician. The box never replaces a clinic visit; from age 30, cervical screening is due every 5–10 years at a public clinic (WHO).
clinic_line.sw: Doa jeusi linaloenea, kiraka cha ngozi kinachobadilika, chunusi zinazoacha makovu, upele kutokana na krimu, au hedhi nzito sana huonwa na mtaalamu wa afya. Sanduku halichukui nafasi ya kliniki; kuanzia miaka 30, uchunguzi wa saratani ya mlango wa kizazi hufanyika kila miaka 5–10 katika kliniki ya umma (WHO).

why.en: A mild, non-stripping cleanser morning and night removes sweat, oil and sunscreen without damaging the skin barrier. In darker skin, irritation and friction are a common trigger for dark marks, so scrubs, antiseptic soaps on the face and any "whitening" wash are left out.

why.en: A moisturiser after cleansing keeps the skin barrier intact, which reduces flaking and the irritation that leaves dark marks. A pea-sized amount twice a day is enough; heavy, perfumed creams sold as "glow" or "fair" creams are not used, because such creams are where hidden lightening agents are found.
why.sw: Krimu ya unyevu baada ya kusafisha hulinda tabaka la kinga la ngozi, jambo linalopunguza ngozi kubambuka na muwasho unaoacha madoa meusi. Kiasi cha punje ya njegere mara mbili kwa siku kinatosha; krimu nzito zenye manukato zinazouzwa kama krimu za "kung’aa" au za "weupe" hazitumiki, kwa sababu ndimo viambato vya kuchubua vilivyofichwa hupatikana.

name.sw: Kinga ya jua ya kila siku, SPF 30–50 ya wigo mpana

why.en: WHO advises broad-spectrum sunscreen on skin that clothes do not cover, together with shade and a hat, and notes that darker-skinned people also develop skin cancers. Dermatologists recommend SPF 30 or more for every skin tone (AAD); in darker skin the daily benefit is fewer dark patches and less melasma, because sun exposure darkens them. This is the safe answer to uneven tone, in place of lightening creams.
why.sw: WHO inashauri kinga ya jua ya wigo mpana kwenye ngozi isiyofunikwa na nguo, pamoja na kivuli na kofia, na inaeleza kuwa watu wenye ngozi nyeusi pia hupata saratani ya ngozi. Madaktari wa ngozi wanapendekeza SPF 30 au zaidi kwa kila rangi ya ngozi (AAD); kwa ngozi nyeusi faida ya kila siku ni mabaka meusi machache na melasma kidogo, kwa sababu jua huyafanya kuwa meusi zaidi. Hii ndiyo njia salama ya kusawazisha rangi ya ngozi, badala ya krimu za kuchubua.

why.en: Lotion on damp skin after the daily bath keeps elbows, knees and shins from the dry, ashy look common in dark skin. Only plain moisturising lotions are offered: no "fair", "white" or "tone" lotion, because many of those sold in markets carry undeclared lightening agents.
why.sw: Losheni kwenye ngozi yenye unyevu baada ya kuoga kila siku huzuia ukavu wa kijivu kwenye viwiko, magoti na miguu unaoonekana mara nyingi kwenye ngozi nyeusi. Losheni za kawaida za unyevu pekee ndizo zinatolewa: hakuna losheni ya "weupe" au ya "kubadilisha rangi", kwa sababu nyingi zinazouzwa sokoni zina viambato vya kuchubua visivyotajwa.

name.sw: Sabuni ya kuogea au krimu ya kuogea

why.en: One or two showers a day in a hot climate need a mild, moisturising cleanser. Cream bars and shower creams dry the skin far less than antiseptic or laundry-style soaps, which strip its oils and worsen itching and ashiness. Medicated and "whitening" soaps are excluded.
why.sw: Kuoga mara moja au mbili kwa siku katika hali ya joto kunahitaji sabuni laini yenye unyevu. Sabuni za krimu na krimu za kuogea hukausha ngozi kidogo sana kuliko sabuni za antiseptiki au za kufulia, ambazo huondoa mafuta ya ngozi na kuongeza muwasho na ukavu. Sabuni za dawa na za "kung’arisha" zimeachwa.

items.qty_formula: about 8 g or ml a day × 30 days ≈ 250 (planning assumption)

why.en: An antiperspirant on fully dry skin after the morning shower controls sweat and odour in Dar es Salaam’s heat; one 50 ml roll-on lasts about a month. Applying it to dry skin and not straight after shaving avoids stinging and the underarm darkening that irritation causes. "Whitening" deodorants are not offered.
why.sw: Antiperspirant kwenye ngozi iliyokauka kabisa baada ya kuoga asubuhi hudhibiti jasho na harufu katika joto la Dar es Salaam; roll-on moja ya ml 50 hudumu takribani mwezi mmoja. Kuipaka kwenye ngozi kavu na si mara baada ya kunyoa huzuia kuwasha na weusi wa kwapani unaosababishwa na muwasho. Deodoranti za "kung’arisha" hazitolewi.

items.qty_formula: once a day; one 50 ml roll-on lasts about a month (planning assumption)

why.en: Dermatologists advise washing Afro-textured hair about once a week or every other week, because coily hair loses moisture easily and frequent shampooing leaves it dry and prone to breakage (AAD). The same routine suits braids and protective styles, with shampoo worked into the scalp.

Utaratibu huo huo unafaa misuko na mitindo ya kulinda nywele, shampuu ikisuguliwa kichwani.

why.en: Conditioner after every wash is the core of the AAD routine for Black hair: it puts back moisture, eases detangling and cuts the breakage that thins the edges. Chemical relaxers and very hot styling tools are not included, because dermatologists link them to breakage and scarring hair loss.

why.en: WHO advises brushing twice a day with a fluoride toothpaste of 1,000–1,500 ppm; low fluoride exposure is one of the main reasons tooth decay keeps rising. Whitening pastes with harsh abrasives and charcoal pastes are left out.

why.en: A brush is replaced about every three months, or sooner when the bristles splay, because a worn brush cleans poorly (NHS). A third of a brush is charged each month and a new one ships every third box.
why.sw: Mswaki hubadilishwa takribani kila miezi mitatu, au mapema zaidi nyuzi zikipinda, kwa sababu mswaki uliochakaa husafisha vibaya (NHS). Theluthi ya mswaki hulipiwa kila mwezi na mswaki mpya hutumwa kila sanduku la tatu.

why.en: A brush does not reach between the teeth, where gum disease and much adult decay begin; the NHS advises cleaning between the teeth once a day with floss or interdental brushes. Gums that bleed at first usually stop within a week or two.
why.sw: Mswaki haufiki katikati ya meno, mahali ambapo magonjwa ya fizi na kuoza kwa meno kwa watu wazima mara nyingi huanzia; NHS inashauri kusafisha katikati ya meno mara moja kwa siku kwa uzi au brashi ndogo. Fizi zinazotoa damu mwanzoni kwa kawaida huacha ndani ya wiki moja au mbili.

services_note.en: skin-consultation: one consultation a year with a partner skin clinician, booked in the app or in store, for dark patches, melasma, acne or a reaction to a cream. Planning fee about TSh 35,000, charged only in the month it is used. This is an estimate, not a quote: it starts from AfyaDepot’s Professional Skin Analysis at TSh 40,000 (10 Nov 2026), with the partner paid about 70% of that (TSh 28,000) and Afya’s fee at partner price × 1.25. In store, at no charge: staff read the label of any cream a member brings and point out mercury, hydroquinone or steroid ingredients.
services_note.sw: skin-consultation: ushauri mmoja kwa mwaka na mtaalamu wa ngozi mshirika, unaopangwa kwenye programu au dukani, kwa mabaka meusi, melasma, chunusi au madhara ya krimu. Ada ya makadirio ni takribani TSh 35,000, inayolipwa tu mwezi unapotumika. Haya ni makadirio, si bei iliyotolewa na mshirika: yanaanzia kwenye Professional Skin Analysis ya AfyaDepot ya TSh 40,000 (10 Nov 2026), mshirika akilipwa takribani asilimia 70 yake (TSh 28,000) na ada ya Afya ikiwa bei ya mshirika × 1.25. Dukani, bila malipo: wafanyakazi husoma lebo ya krimu yoyote anayoleta mwanachama na kuonyesha viambato vya zebaki, haidrokwinoni au steroidi.

pricing_rule.formula: D4 (10 Nov 2026): core price = shelf value of the month’s goods × (1 − 3% / 6% / 9% for 1 / 6 / 12-month plans), nearest 500, never above shelf; packing M 5,000 and delivery 3,500 included. Check: price − goods at landed cost (R3 planning share 78%) − packing − delivery − 1% points ≥ 0.
pricing_rule.note: The luxury line is priced as its own line at shelf price, outside the saving. No medicines in this box.

open.en: The box does not pay its way on the 6- and 12-month plans when delivered monthly: the shelf value is TSh 47,973, below the about TSh 70,300 needed to cover an M box and a delivery on the 12-month plan. The proposed fix is to deliver two months of goods every two months (or let the member collect monthly in store); Premium and Luxury cover monthly delivery through their luxury line.
open.sw: Sanduku halijilipii kwenye mipango ya miezi 6 na 12 likisafirishwa kila mwezi: thamani ya rafu ni TSh 47,973, chini ya takribani TSh 70,300 zinazohitajika kulipia sanduku la M na usafirishaji kwenye mpango wa miezi 12. Pendekezo ni kusafirisha bidhaa za miezi miwili kila miezi miwili (au mwanachama achukue kila mwezi dukani); Premium na Anasa zinalipia usafirishaji wa kila mwezi kupitia bidhaa yao ya anasa.
